comment: TempoPrb - hardware probe, not a release effect. Tests whether a custom effect can read the pedal's own patch tempo through the call chain TAPEECH3 uses (docs/TEMPO-SYNC.md sections 4 and 8). Input passes through; the probe adds beeps (value changed), clicks (value as a delay time) or a data tone to record and decode (src/probes/tempoprb/decode_dump.py). Mode = BLIP / CLICK / DUMP; Watch = which value (RCPE = the TAPEECH3 result, X = the word it starts from, SYNC = our Sync knob in the host table, ROW, TABLE); Time = dummy free time; Level = probe sound level; Sync = TAPEECH3-style sync knob with pedal_flags 0x28; Call = OFF/ON, calls the firmware's state[24] helper (riskiest part).
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> Fx_DLY_, same category as TAPEECH3.
fxid_comment: Probe id, kept away from the pack's 480..496 so it never takes the next effect's number.

params.name: Mode
params.comment: What you hear. BLIP = a beep when the watched value changes. CLICK = a click every N ms, N taken from the watched value (low hum if it is not a usable delay). DUMP = data tone to record and decode. Default BLIP.

params.name: Watch
params.comment: Which value BLIP and CLICK follow. RCPE = the TAPEECH3 result y (needs Call ON), X = the second-table word TAPEECH3 starts from, SYNC = our Sync knob as the host table holds it (turn Sync: it must beep), ROW = our whole second-table row, TABLE = rows 0..15 of both tables. Default SYNC, the calibration check.

params.name: Time
params.comment: Dummy free-time knob at descriptor entry 4, where TAPEECH3's B4 = 4 read looks. Does nothing to the sound; it shows up in the dump.

params.name: Level
params.comment: Level of the probe sound. The input is never changed.

params.name: Sync
params.comment: TAPEECH3-style sync knob at descriptor entry 6 (B4 = 6), max 15, pedal_flags 0x28 (40). OFF, S1..S15 = TAPEECH3's division index. The flag is what may make the pedal treat this as a tempo-synced effect.

params.name: Call
params.comment: OFF = only reads memory. ON = also calls the firmware's state[24] helper with the second-table word, exactly as TAPEECH3 does. Riskiest step: turn it on last.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build (loads the descriptor and the 0x28 flag without running the probe).
